nodes.label: start
nodes.what: A run begins at the interview.

nodes.label: work
nodes.what: The stage's role agents act: each writes only the files its role owns.

nodes.label: gate
nodes.what: The flow's own checks run: lint, simulation, Vivado reports, the stage gates. No model decides.

nodes.label: review
nodes.what: A snapshot of the design is taken; a person may approve, edit or rewind. Always pauses before the board.

nodes.label: advance
nodes.what: Code picks the next stage from the gate result: the next stage, or the stage that owns the failure.

nodes.label: end
nodes.what: The run stops: every stage passed, or a limit was reached.

fixes.name: Whole skills from load_skill
fixes.text: When a role loaded several skills at once, the tool layer's output limit cut the middle out of them without saying so. load_skill now returns whole skills up to the limit and names the ones it held back, so the role can load each by name.

fixes.name: The debug core's own timing exceptions
fixes.text: The exceptions gate failed every build with a logic analyser in it, because the analyser core brings timing exceptions that Vivado ignores. The gate now reports those as information and still fails on the design's own.

fixes.name: A build cache for Vivado
fixes.text: A repeated build of an unchanged design now comes from a cache, and a later stage resumes from the last checkpoint. One agent run's build sequence on the c10 task took 304.6 s instead of a modelled 1266.9 s, with the same result.

middleware.name: FilesystemMiddleware
middleware.words: the built-in file tools on the jailed folder; moves a tool result of 80,000 characters or more to a file

middleware.name: _ParentNotifierMiddleware
middleware.words: wakes a parent agent that started this one in the background; does nothing here

middleware.name: SummarizationMiddleware
middleware.words: summarises older turns once the transcript reaches about 170,000 tokens, keeping the last 6 messages; before that, cuts file contents the model wrote (over 2,000 characters) out of all but the last 20 messages

middleware.name: PatchToolCallsMiddleware
middleware.words: answers any tool call left without a result, so the transcript stays valid

middleware.name: AnthropicPromptCachingMiddleware
middleware.words: prompt caching, for Anthropic chat models only; other models pass straight through

middleware.name: UnsupportedContentMiddleware
middleware.words: replaces content the model cannot take, such as images

roles.backend: an in-memory folder seeded with only the role's inputs; outputs copied in through the jail
roles.label: Clarifier
roles.what: Turns the plain-English request into a structured spec, asking about what it leaves open.

roles.backend: an in-memory folder seeded with only the role's inputs; outputs copied in through the jail
roles.label: Modeller
roles.what: Writes a short Python reference model of the design from the spec alone. Blind to the RTL: never sees it.

roles.backend: an in-memory folder seeded with only the role's inputs; outputs copied in through the jail
roles.label: Verifier
roles.what: Writes the tests and the test plan from the spec and the model. Never sees the RTL. Its own tests never decide a result; the hidden tests do.

roles.backend: the real design folder, every path checked by the role's jail
roles.label: Designer
roles.what: Writes the architecture, SystemVerilog, constraints and probes, and does every repair. Vivado implementation is run by the deterministic flow, not by this role.
